scope: All 31 original non-PASS findings; FIXED means local repository only.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `/review` selector text “Select a service (optional)” has **3.14:1** contrast instead of 4.5:1. Evidence: `contrast.json`; `src/features/reviews/service-select.tsx:117`, `.truncate.text-slate/65`, #8a929d on white.
findings.businessImpact: Visitors with low vision can struggle to identify the control.
findings.recommendedAction: Use an existing text token meeting 4.5:1; verify default, selected and focus states.
findings.remediationEvidence: Review-selector contrast remains outside these five remediation phases.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Initial homepage mobile loading recorded one `/_next/image` HTTP 400. Focused home and `/reviews` retries loaded all images without failures; fresh signed URLs were unexpired. Carousel/lazy images loaded after being visited individually. Evidence: `live-crawl.json` versus `followup.json`.
findings.businessImpact: Transient photo loss can weaken trust. The first failure’s cause is not proven.
findings.recommendedAction: Inspect cold-cache optimizer/log evidence and stale/expired signed URLs; retain text fallback and private storage protections.
findings.remediationEvidence: Intermittent image observation not reproduced as a permanent defect; image delivery needs independent audit.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Admin operations, real review invitations/uploads, password reset emails and live AI replies were source-reviewed but not exercised as real workflows. Anonymous admin pages redirect to login.
findings.businessImpact: Operational failures may remain outside public-page checks.
findings.recommendedAction: Test these in isolated staging with role-specific accounts. Do not claim every admin or private URL was audited interactively.
findings.remediationEvidence: Private workflows not exercised with production data.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Configured database contains **15 service requests and 9 customers**; latest inspected request is 20 November 2026. No fresh booking was submitted. Evidence: `integrations.json`, aggregate counts and limited timestamp/status fields only.
findings.businessImpact: A current deployment, permission or environment regression could still lose paid leads.
findings.recommendedAction: Authorize one clearly marked test with controlled contact details; verify exactly one CRM request, association, response, notifications and conversion. Agree handling/cleanup separately.
findings.remediationEvidence: No isolated Apex staging database/test record authorization identified.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Booking route has no application rate limiter, honeypot/challenge or equivalent admission control. It goes from validation to persistence and notifications. Chat/review controls do not protect it. External firewall rules were unavailable. Evidence: full `src/app/api/book-now/route.ts` and submission adapter.
findings.businessImpact: Bots can pollute CRM, consume email quota and flood Telegram.
findings.recommendedAction: Add or verify effective booking-specific throttling/abuse protection and monitoring. Establish actual platform coverage before relying on it.
findings.remediationEvidence: Durable limiter and role/concurrency tests complete; hosted migration, salt, WAF and proxy acceptance still required.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: The 8 KB limit trusts Content-Length. A **9,082-byte** request gave 413 with the header but reached stub persistence and returned 201 without it. Evidence: `booking-route-synthetic.json`; actual route executed locally without external writes.
findings.businessImpact: Intended route limit is bypassable; hosting’s upper bound is not the same control.
findings.recommendedAction: Count streamed body bytes before parsing and enforce the cap independently of headers.
findings.remediationEvidence: Actual streamed byte cap and deadline pass route regressions.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Booking creation has no stable idempotency key. UI warns users to call after an uncertain response, but a retry can create another request. Resend idempotency applies only to an already-created request ID. Evidence: booking types/model/repository, modal catch message, email adapter.
findings.businessImpact: Lost-response retries can duplicate leads and notifications.
findings.recommendedAction: Use a per-submission key enforced transactionally; distinguish retries from legitimate separate requests. No duplicate production write was attempted.
findings.remediationEvidence: Notification ambiguity reduced and retry guidance improved; backend booking idempotency remains absent.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Resend domain read returned **401 restricted_api_key**. This means insufficient read permission, not an invalid sending key. Sender-domain DNS, inbox/spam receipt, Telegram membership/topic routing and production credentials were not verified by a new message.
findings.businessImpact: Stored leads may not reach operations promptly; customers may miss confirmation.
findings.recommendedAction: Obtain domain/delivery-log read evidence; verify SPF/DKIM/DMARC and actual destination, then perform the authorized end-to-end test. Do not rotate the key just because domain-list access is restricted.
findings.remediationEvidence: No approved isolated inbox/Telegram destination or fresh delivery test.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Both channels are awaited after DB creation. Telegram is bounded by a timeout; no explicit application deadline was found around the Resend SDK send. Failure statuses exist, but automatic retries/outbox/alerts were not established. Evidence: submission-adapter, email, Telegram and repository sources.
findings.businessImpact: Provider delay can delay the HTTP response; delivery failure may require manual recovery.
findings.recommendedAction: Define bounded delivery, failure monitoring and an idempotent retry procedure. Verify failures cannot create duplicate requests/messages.
findings.remediationEvidence: Bounded sends/RPCs and settled notifications implemented; durable outbox/recovery monitoring not added.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Published `GTM-5JLZPN4Q` resource has **one base `__googtag` tag**, for `G-50J6LW5JET`, triggered on `gtm.init`. It has no forwarding tags/triggers for the six custom events. During interaction, booking_click/form_start appeared in dataLayer without matching collection requests. Evidence: `public-gtm.js` resource block and `tags.json`.
findings.businessImpact: The intended lead measurement pipeline is incomplete; conversion bidding would lack reliable custom signals.
findings.recommendedAction: Configure/publish the exact allowlisted Custom Event mapping and safe parameters; prove all six in Preview and DebugView before advertising.
findings.remediationEvidence: Six-event GTM draft prepared; account import and receipt not verified.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `/admin/login?audit=AUDIT_MARKER` generated an attempted GA4 page_view containing the admin path and raw query marker. It was intercepted before transmission. Evidence: `tags.json`, private scenario.
findings.businessImpact: Sensitive/token URL context can reach analytics; admin traffic contaminates measurement.
findings.recommendedAction: Exclude private routes/hostnames in every Google tag; sanitize page_location/referrer/link URLs; test review/campaign token paths too. App event guards do not control automatic Google events.
findings.remediationEvidence: Application guard and sanitized context verified; real Google network collection requires account verification.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Public GA4 script has automatic form measurement enabled plus automatic phone/address/email/user-data flags. Fresh browser received GA cookies without a consent interaction. No duplicate collection event or customer PII transmission was demonstrated in this audit. Evidence: `public-gtag.js`, `tags.json`.
findings.businessImpact: Automatic events may compete with success-only events; collection needs approved privacy/consent behavior.
findings.recommendedAction: Disable competing form collection for this contract; review user-provided-data settings and jurisdiction-specific consent. Service-text consent is not analytics consent.
findings.remediationEvidence: External analytics defaults off; conflicting GA4 automatic settings still require account changes.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Authenticated GA4 key events, Google Ads linking/import, primary/secondary conversions, counting/attribution settings, GTM Preview and DebugView were unavailable.
findings.businessImpact: Campaigns could optimize toward missing, duplicate or low-quality goals.
findings.recommendedAction: Verify **one accepted booking → one GA4 event → one intended Ads conversion**, and zero for failures. Phone clicks are not calls or qualified leads. [DebugView guidance](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/7201382).
findings.remediationEvidence: Authenticated conversion configuration and Preview/DebugView access unavailable.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `/?book=1&gclid=AUDIT_MARKER&utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc` became `/`. `BookNowUrlSync` removes the whole query; booking storage has campaignToken/sourcePath, not GCLID/GBRAID/WBRAID/UTM fields. Whether Google captured attribution first is unproven. Evidence: `tags.json`, context/model/repository.
findings.businessImpact: Auto-open URL attribution is timing-dependent; offline lead-quality matching lacks a persisted click ID.
findings.recommendedAction: Preserve approved attribution before cleanup and test real Ads attribution. Add consent-aware backend attribution only if required by the selected measurement design.
findings.remediationEvidence: No paid-click storage or privacy-approved attribution implementation.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Quo `GET /webhooks` returned **zero subscriptions**. All three Quo tables returned 404 via configured database REST and are absent from exposed schema. Local tracking is disabled; signing/reconciliation secrets are absent. Production Quo route GETs return 405, proving route presence only.
findings.businessImpact: Operational ingestion/synchronization is not ready in the inspected configuration.
findings.recommendedAction: Follow staging runbook: both migrations/grants, scope, secrets, one webhook, protected scheduler, replay/resume monitoring, retention and rollback. REST absence does not prove physical table absence; production env values were not inspected.
findings.remediationEvidence: Staging configuration/schema/subscription not available; production unchanged.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: No real calls were made. Ringing/forwarding, voicemail, callback/after-hours handling and staffing are unverified. Quo implementation deliberately has no campaign/session attribution or qualified phone_lead event.
findings.businessImpact: Call-focused ads could spend without proving response or qualified-call return.
findings.recommendedAction: Test routing and choose a proven call-attribution solution. Quo itself is not mandatory if an equivalent verified solution is used; phone-lead optimization must wait for reliable measurement.
findings.remediationEvidence: Real answered/missed calls and operational response not tested.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: HTTP→HTTPS uses 308; HTTPS www→non-www and retired plumbing/air-quality paths use 307. Chains resolve successfully. Evidence: `followup.json`, `next.config.ts`.
findings.businessImpact: Temporary redirects make permanent consolidation less explicit.
findings.recommendedAction: Use reviewed permanent redirects if the move is permanent; preserve relevant destinations and attribution. No destination failure was observed.
findings.remediationEvidence: Legacy redirect optimization not changed.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: No Search Console URL inspection, coverage, manual actions or sitemap-submission evidence. Public site search did not establish reliable domain-specific index coverage.
findings.businessImpact: HTTP 200 does not establish organic visibility or indexing.
findings.recommendedAction: Inspect the verified domain property, representative URLs and sitemap processing. Organic indexing is not a universal prerequisite for Search Ads.
findings.remediationEvidence: Search Console/indexing access unavailable.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Site describes an independent-provider coordination model across selected counties in five states. It does not establish five staffed business locations. Legal operator and local capacity evidence remain outstanding. Evidence: About, company.ts, BUSINESS_FACTS.md and schema.
findings.businessImpact: Unsupported locality/credential claims create trust and policy risk.
findings.recommendedAction: Confirm real operating model, service capacity and profile eligibility. Use genuine locations only; do not invent an address for SEO. [Google business guidance](https://support.google.com/business/answer/3038177).
findings.remediationEvidence: Verified local-business facts/profile access required.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: AC-repair mobile LCP 3.088s exceeds the 2.5s good threshold; TBT 761ms indicates main-thread cost. Home mobile TBT is 358ms.
findings.businessImpact: Paid mobile users may encounter slower rendering/interaction.
findings.recommendedAction: Profile hydration, main-thread work, hero delivery, unused JS and render-blocking work. TBT is not measured INP, and one lab run is not field p75. [Web Vitals](https://web.dev/articles/vitals).
findings.remediationEvidence: Mobile performance remediation outside specified phases; no new Lighthouse claim.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Home Lighthouse mobile contrast warning lowered accessibility to 96; visible footer at 412px and ordinary scrolled page scans found no contrast violation. Evidence: `contrast.json`, `footer-412.png`. Offscreen content-visibility is a hypothesis, not proven cause.
findings.businessImpact: Tool discrepancy could hide a rendering issue or be a false positive.
findings.recommendedAction: Reproduce visible, focus and offscreen states before changing colors. Keep the separately confirmed review-selector failure open.
findings.remediationEvidence: Performance and image optimization follow-up not implemented.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Public PageSpeed field-data request returned **429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED**. Current CrUX/Search Console p75 LCP/INP/CLS were not obtained. Evidence: `provider-followup.json`.
findings.businessImpact: Real-user performance remains unknown.
findings.recommendedAction: Obtain quota-enabled field data or consent-appropriate RUM. Establish monitoring for initial traffic; do not claim field CWV passes from Lighthouse or require an impossible pre-launch traffic history.
findings.remediationEvidence: Field Core Web Vitals dataset/access unavailable.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `npm audit --omit=dev` reports **three vulnerable package entries: next critical, sharp high, source-map-js high**. Versions: Next **16.3.4**, sharp **0.35.4**, source-map-js **1.2.1**. App Router plus Server Actions matches the preconditions of the Next Server Actions DoS advisory. Evidence: `npm-audit.json`, lockfile/admin actions.
findings.businessImpact: Known defects create avoidable availability/security exposure before acquisition spend. No exploit or compromise was demonstrated.
findings.recommendedAction: Upgrade a compatible patched set and lockfile; registry suggested Next 16.4.6 at audit time. Verify sharp >=0.35.5/source-map-js >=1.2.2, then build/test/stage and confirm deployed versions. [Server Actions advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r).
findings.remediationEvidence: Patched lockfile; final full npm audit zero advisories, build/regressions pass.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Critical next/og RCE requires attacker-controlled SVG/style inputs; this OG image uses static local content, so that condition was not found. Image-optimizer RCE depends on platform/library conditions; deployed runtime unknown. Remote image patterns allow signed paths on any *.supabase.co host.
findings.businessImpact: Package severity is not proof of exploitable live RCE. Conditional image risks still warrant remediation.
findings.recommendedAction: Patch; narrow remote image hosts where appropriate; assess deployed platform conditions. [next/og advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j), [image optimization advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw), [SSRF advisory](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cjq9-62q9-8jv4).
findings.remediationEvidence: Framework/image dependencies patched; broad signed-image host allowlist retained and deployed platform unverified.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Migrations contain RLS and restricted grants, but current hosted pg_policies, function ACLs, authenticated-role behavior, storage, backups, hosting environment/WAF/logs were not comprehensively accessible.
findings.businessImpact: Deployed permission or environment drift may differ from source intent.
findings.recommendedAction: Obtain read-only actual-project access, inspect advisors/policies/grants and test each role through PostgREST in staging. Do not equate anonymous denial with complete RLS validation. [Supabase API security](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/api/securing-your-api).
findings.remediationEvidence: Hosted RLS/storage/account inspection unavailable; local migration ACL tests pass.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Sampled responses lack CSP and Permissions-Policy; baseline headers are present. Evidence: headers and next.config.ts.
findings.businessImpact: Reduced defense in depth against injection/unnecessary browser capabilities.
findings.recommendedAction: Inventory resources, stage a report-only CSP, then enforce a reviewed policy; add minimal Permissions-Policy. Absence alone does not prove an exploit or automatic Ads rejection.
findings.remediationEvidence: CSP/Permissions-Policy not imposed without staging inventory.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `/privacy-policy` and `/privacy` return 404. No operative privacy route is implemented/linked while the site collects contact/request data and runs analytics. Evidence: live HTTP, route inventory, booking copy and BUSINESS_FACTS.md.
findings.businessImpact: Visitors lack clear disclosure of processing, provider sharing, retention and request rights. Launch-governance/policy risk.
findings.recommendedAction: Publish owner/legal-reviewed policy reflecting actual operator, purposes, processors, sharing, retention/deletion and contact; link beside forms/footer. [Google data collection policy](https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6020956).
findings.remediationEvidence: Canonical draft route returns 200/noindex; operative policy requires approval.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: `/terms` and `/terms-of-service` return 404. Central contact email/address/structured hours are null; legal operator and warranty/responsibility terms remain outstanding. Evidence: company.ts, BUSINESS_FACTS.md.
findings.businessImpact: Customers cannot fully assess service responsibility, fees, guarantees or dispute process.
findings.recommendedAction: Obtain approved operator identity, reachable support/privacy contact, days/time zone and service terms. Publish a real address only if applicable; never fabricate one. This is not a claim that every site must disclose a storefront address.
findings.remediationEvidence: Canonical draft route returns 200/noindex; business identity and terms approval missing.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Live claims include EPA 608 Certified Technicians, 10+ Years Technician Experience, Same-Day Service Available and service calls starting at $89. Prior client approval exists in source comments, but current supporting evidence was not independently obtained.
findings.businessImpact: Unsubstantiated claims can cause complaints or policy problems; this audit does not assert they are false.
findings.recommendedAction: Verify whose credentials/experience apply, availability/service areas and fee/credit/offer exclusions; align ad copy with proof. [Google misrepresentation policy](https://support.google.com/adspolicy/answer/6020955).
findings.remediationEvidence: Owner substantiation of existing business claims required.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Advertiser verification, billing, Ads/GA4 linking, conversion imports, templates, locations, schedules, budgets, keywords/negatives and draft claims were not inspected.
findings.businessImpact: Correct website behavior alone cannot prevent waste or account-policy problems.
findings.recommendedAction: Review account and draft campaigns without enabling ads; target only confirmed service areas/hours. Google determines actual approval.
findings.remediationEvidence: Ads/account/advertiser configuration not accessed or activated.

findings.descriptionAndEvidence: Service pages support focused campaigns, but appliance types largely share a hub. ZIP/service capacity and qualified-lead feedback were not supplied as a campaign plan. Evidence: route/content inventory, business register, booking/Quo contracts.
findings.businessImpact: Broad traffic can generate unserviceable requests or clicks without profitable jobs.
findings.recommendedAction: Start with verified services/geographies and relevant existing pages; define qualified lead/job outcomes. Create new pages only with original approved content and campaign need.
findings.remediationEvidence: Service capacity, campaign scope and qualification inputs required.
